bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- Mini fixes and polish update
- Update prompt now appears more reliably outside Home (including Settings)
- Fixed Google account sync flow from Settings

## Improvements

- Added quick Settings actions for feedback, rating, and sharing CogniFocus
- Improved prompt timing so feedback and review prompts do not overlap

## Why this matters

What's New (v4.3.2) is one of those tidy-up releases that does not need a parade, but it still helps the app feel less fussy. Small fixes matter here because CogniFocus is supposed to get out of your way fast. Tap in, start the thing, dodge the scroll spiral, continue your tiny heroic quest. That is the whole deal.

- Mini fixes and polish update gets a little more room to breathe.
- Update prompt now appears more reliably outside Home (including Settings) gets a little more room to breathe.
- Fixed Google account sync flow from Settings gets a little more room to breathe.
- Added quick Settings actions for feedback, rating, and sharing CogniFocus gets a little more room to breathe.

So yes, this is a smaller note. The point is still real: fewer weird little moments, clearer feedback, and less friction between you and the session you meant to start. The Goblin may still be dramatic about it, obviously, but the app should feel calmer where it counts.
